query: How does resolution time vary by agent and issue type?

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: Directly provides the issue-type axis the query needs for grouping resolution time. Values are sound readings of short_description (database access, VPN, intranet). Partly derivable from existing 'category' but adds finer granularity.

per_column.name: assigned_agent
per_column.rationale: The agent axis is central to the query, but this appears largely redundant with the existing 'assigned_to' original column. Values are grounded/consistent, but it mostly restates existing data.

per_column.name: severity_signal
per_column.rationale: Offers a new axis (severity/nature of failure) to explain resolution-time variation. Mostly well grounded in descriptions; some mappings are looser (e.g., 'connectivity_loss' for a database access issue is a mild stretch), and a correct 'Unknown' for silent rows is appropriate.

per_column.name: technical_system_type
per_column.rationale: Provides a system-level grouping distinct from issue_category, useful for comparison. Somewhat overlaps issue_category conceptually but at a coarser system axis. Values are reasonable readings, though some (intranet -> infrastructure vs network_vpn) are debatable.

per_column.name: closing_agent_match
per_column.rationale: A boolean of whether closing agent equals assigned agent gives a plausible operational signal for resolution behavior. Derivable from closed_by vs assigned_to, but those fields are not shown in the evidence samples, so the specific true/false values cannot be verified from the provided source text.

judge.rationale: The added columns supply genuine axes (issue type, severity, system type) that support grouping resolution time, directly serving the query. assigned_agent is largely redundant with the existing assigned_to column, lowering its leverage. Values are generally sound readings of the source text with appropriate 'Unknown' handling; a few categorizations are mild stretches and closing_agent_match values are not fully verifiable from the shown evidence, but no clear invented facts or contradictions were observed.
